bagPolicy.summary: Only clutches, wristlets and fanny packs up to 4" x 6" x 1.5" are allowed. Purses and backpacks are not permitted.
allowed: Fanny packs up to 4" x 6" x 1.5"
Medical and diaper bags up to 14" x 14" x 6"
prohibited: Hard case containers such as coolers
Water bottles at concerts, including empty ones
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are inspected and x-rayed at designated entrances. The policies FAQ lists Binbox bag lockers in the Grand Atrium plaza from $15 per bag (card or mobile pay only), opening 30 minutes before doors, with no access during the event. Bag rules can vary for concerts and special events.

parking.note: Ball Arena offers several parking lots with varying prices depending on the event. Parking lots open 3 hours before events, and credit/debit cards are accepted at all lots. The Tundra lot offers a $5 discount for card payments.

rideshare.note: Use the Rideshare Lot in the 4Runner West parking lot. Enter at 5th Street and Walnut Street. Rideshare, taxi, limo and accessible pickup and drop-off use this lot.

concessions.note: Ball Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including craft beers, cocktails, and a variety of hot entrees. Highlights include Big Belly Brothers BBQ, Billy's Gourmet Hot Dogs, and Cluck Shack Chicken, with options for dietary preferences such as gluten-friendly and vegetarian. Special offerings include $5 Fan Friendly items and frozen cocktails.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible pick-up and drop-off is at the roundabout on 9th Street. Free sensory bags are available at all Guest Relations kiosks, and Sensory Nooks are at Sections 120 and 340. The nursing suite at Section 132 is wheelchair accessible. Medical bags up to 14 x 14 x 6 inches are allowed after inspection.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are mobile only and sold on Ticketmaster. The box office is closed to the public, including on event days, and will call is not available.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The main entrance is the Grand Atrium. For general admission concerts, you can line up at the designated door from 10 a.m. on show day, starting at the Grand Atrium. CLEAR members can use the CLEAR Lane at the Altitude Authentics Entrance.
